mission.title: The Spider
mission.description: Track down the shape-shifter that has been pillaging Wright Research's facilities.

npc.say: What, you didn't see Lambright stick their head in a minute ago? I was about to ask them what happened to their vacation, but then they sort of got this funny look, and ran out.
Oh. I guess I just spaced out.
Lambright needs to take it easy. Some of those old-timers still think they're going to change the world.

She didn't make a sound. It must have been painless...but I wouldn't want to go that way. It just seems so...empty. What's life worth if it can stop, just like that?
From nothing to nothing...
I'm sorry. I didn't mean to sound so maudlin.

phase.briefing:
Warrior, a group of operatives managed to locate the individual apparently responsible for the Wright security problems. Whoever it was, they shifted forms when trying to escape from the operatives; it looks like we're dealing with someone who can vary their signal to alter their RSI at will. This, coupled with seeming inside knowledge of Wright's operations, has allowed them to pillage the company's facilities. Now that we know what we're up against, we can watch for their signal alterations.
We've just picked up another security alert at a Wright office. Get to the area as quickly as possible, and look for traces of the culprit. We'll be running an area scan to try to pick up any signals that transform themselves.

enter.say: From the radio chatter, it sounds like Wright's security is on their way, but I think you've got them beat by a few minutes. So far, I'm only scanning standard office activity there.

objective.text: Search the office for traces of the culprit

done.say:
Sounds like they already made a break for it.
Hey, security just caught up with you. I think that's our exit cue. Maybe we'll have more luck with the area scan.

phase.briefing: Yes, we detected a signal transformation at about the same time that Wright's security forces arrived on the scene. More transformations have made the signal difficult to track, but we've located another Wright office along one of their projected paths. We don't have the resources to do a wide scan right now, so we need to confirm where the target went.

enter.say:
More office noise... It doesn't sound like their security has been alerted to any problems at that location. I hope this is the right track.
Hey, you hear about EPN sending reinforcements off to that mystery zone on the surface that even the Machines avoid? Rumor is they've been seeing more Sentinels than usual just outside it, and the Kid himself is heading out with more ships to help protect that expedition they sent out there a month ago. I wonder if they're on to something.

done.say: That's our bogey's MO! I'm calling in the scan!

phase.briefing: Good work, {player}. We've caught another signal transformation. There was only one this time, so we're fairly confident of their destination. I'm marking it for you now.

enter.say: Getting a lot of electronic activity in there, and there's some kind of signal... I don't know what that is--nothing that looks like our morpher. I'm going to see if Tyndall can squeeze out another area scan.

done.say: Whoa. Some kind of super-encrypted signal just went out from that terminal. Let me see if... Nope, no trace.

Not sure what half the stuff in there is, but it looks like some of it has been cobbled together from that stolen Wright prototype whose schematics we tracked down a few weeks back. It's...some kind of interface or broadcast device, I think, but not like anything I've seen before. We're gonna have to get a tech team to take that stuff in for a good hard look.

phase.briefing: We picked up a quick series of signal transformations, {player}; too quick to maintain our tracking. However, we have just detected an alert at a Wright facility not far from the tracking area.

enter.say:
Jeez... Mauser--or whoever this is--sure can move. I don't know how we'll catch them at this rate...
Hey, on Wright's security channel, they're saying that this is a medical emergency, not an alarm response.

done.say:
Can't really explain this to the people there, I suppose, but I'm pretty sure that isn't whoever they think it is. The residual program is not a human RSI; it's some other kind of shell, and breaking down rapidly, too. It probably wasn't stable to begin with.
Ya know, I'll bet this was our shape-shifter; that computer you activated, and the signal it sent, could have been a shut-down command for this thing. Like, it was just following a script someone had given it to gather stuff from different Wright facilities, and it was programmed with Wright access codes, and RSIs of employees who were supposed to be somewhere else at the time. But who would do that?

mission.finish:
That's...an interesting theory, operative. It does seem that someone with great knowledge of Wright Research's operations must have been involved in this plot. It looks like they were constructing something in that lab, using stolen Wright programs and materials.
We know Mauser was a skilled technician, and spent time in Wright's surface lab. Possibly this was more of his handiwork. We've secured the equipment you found in the lab, and we're going over it now. We'll find out what was going on there.
Oh, {player}... We've received multiple reports that Carlyne has been seen inside the Matrix again. There's some indication that he's approached the Merovingian, who has been acting very secretively since capturing--apparently--the "biological interface program" from Ouroboros. That was the program Carlyne's rival, Halborn, had wanted. I'll let you know when we have more details.
